stanimal

Bayesian animal models in Stan, for estimating the additive genetic covariance matrix (G) of one or more traits from a pedigree or a genomic relationship matrix.

stanimal is built for many traits measured on a moderate number of individuals. Covariances, standard deviations, heritabilities and fixed effects come back on the original scale of the data, the relationship matrix enters through its eigendecomposition (computed once per fit), and incomplete trait records are used as they are, without dropping anyone.

Install 

install.packages("cmdstanr", repos = c("https://stan-dev.r-universe.dev",
                                       getOption("repos")))
cmdstanr::install_cmdstan()

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("diogro/stanimal/package")

Requires R 4.0.0 or later. Fits use CmdStan through cmdstanr by default, with rstan as a fallback.

Quick start

The package ships two real datasets measured on the same cranial landmarks: ratones_morpho (329 mice from a selection experiment, with their pedigree) and opossum (553 opossums, with a genomic relationship matrix).

library(stanimal)
traits <- c("IS_PM", "NSL_NA", "PT_BA", "BA_OPI")
opossum[traits] <- log(opossum[traits])

design <- animal_design(cbind(IS_PM, NSL_NA, PT_BA, BA_OPI) ~ sex + age,
                        opossum)
fit <- lmm_animal(design$Y, design$X,
                  opossum_grm[rownames(design$Y), rownames(design$Y)])
fit$summary(c("h2", "corrG"))
draws_mean(fit, "G")

What it fits

Goal Call
One trait, heritability lmm_animal(y, X, A)
Several traits, covariance structure lmm_animal(Y, X, A)
Many traits, a sparse low-rank G lmm_animal(Y, X, A, genetic_structure = "factor")
G and E driven by the same latent factors add residual_structure = "shared_factor"
Many correlated traits on one size gradient lmm_animal(Y, X, A, correlation_prior = "size")
Phenotypic covariance only, no pedigree lm_phen_cov(Y, X)
Missing trait values leave the NAs in Y; imputed_data(fit) returns the completed data
Each individual’s breeding value breeding_values(fit)
Compare two models loo::loo_compare(fit_loo(a), fit_loo(b))
Check that a model reproduces the data posterior_predictive(fit)
A quick approximate fit lmm_animal_laplace(Y, X, A)
Relationship matrices makeA(pedigree), genomic_relationship(M)

Where to go next

  • The articles work through complete analyses, comparing each posterior with a simulated truth or with the data: one trait, several traits, real mouse data, a sparse factor G, choosing between covariance structures, incomplete records, breeding values, phenotypic covariance and its factor model, the Laplace approximation and the Gibbs sampler.
  • The reference documents every function and dataset.
  • The README has the mathematics of each model, and AGENTS.md is a compact guide to the interface and to the prior choices the function signatures leave to you.

stanimal is under development, and the interface may still change.
